title: Images, Captions, and Shifting Context
text:
Images detached from their original context can acquire meanings their creators never intended. A photograph taken at one protest may be circulated as evidence of a different event, and the caption supplies the interpretation that the picture alone cannot. Such recontextualisation is rarely a single lie; it is more often a gradual drift in which accurate material is placed inside a misleading frame.

Fact-checkers therefore examine not only whether an image is authentic but also where it first appeared and how its description changed over time. Reverse-search tools can reveal earlier publication dates that contradict the story attached to a picture. Yet even a verified image may mislead if the surrounding text selects only the details that support a preferred conclusion.

questions.text: According to the first paragraph, what can happen to images detached from their original context?
options: They can acquire meanings their creators never intended

questions.text: What do fact-checkers examine, according to the second paragraph?
options: Only the colour of an image
Where an image first appeared and how its description changed
The number of likes it receives
The camera model used to take it

questions.text: What does the passage imply about recontextualisation?
options: It is usually a single deliberate lie
It is often a gradual drift that places accurate material in a misleading frame

questions.text: Why might a verified image still mislead its audience?
options: Because verification always removes all context
Because the surrounding text can select only the details that support a preferred conclusion
Because every verified image is fabricated

vocabulary.definition: placing material in a new setting that changes how it is understood
a short piece of text that explains or interprets a picture
confirmed as true or authentic through checking
the perspective or setting within which something is presented and understood

paragraph_translations: تستطيع الصور المنفصلة عن سياقها الأصلي أن تكتسب معاني لم يقصدها مبدعوها. فقد تُلتقط صورة في احتجاج واحد ثم تُتداول بوصفها دليلًا على حدث مختلف، ويقدّم التعليق المرفق بها التفسير الذي لا تستطيع الصورة وحدها تقديمه. وهذه إعادة التأطير نادرًا ما تكون كذبة واحدة؛ بل هي في الغالب انجراف تدريجي تُوضع فيه مادة صحيحة داخل إطار مضلل.

لذلك يفحص المدققون في الحقائق لا أن كانت الصورة أصلية فحسب، بل أيضًا أين ظهرت أولًا وكيف تغيّر وصفها مع الوقت. فقد تكشف أدوات البحث العكسي عن تواريخ نشر أسبق تناقض القصة المرفقة بالصورة. ومع ذلك قد تضلل الصورة الموثّقة إذا اختار النص المحيط تفاصيل تدعم استنتاجًا مفضّلًا دون غيرها.
